description: Read the formulas and computed values of one cell or a rectangular range in a session: the way to check what a cell or a block of cells computes. Pass a single cell ("B4", "Sheet1!B4") or a range ("A1:D10"). Returns {worksheet, range, cell_count, cells: [{cell, formula, value, value_type}]}, with formula including its leading "=" (null for constants and empty cells) and value_type "number", "string", "boolean", "error" or "empty". Read a block in one call rather than cell by cell; to read values by defined name use get_outputs, and for the cells that feed one use trace_dependencies. Every cell in the rectangle is returned, up to 2,000 cells a call; a larger range fails with range_too_large, so read a big block in pieces. An unknown sheet or malformed range fails the call.

range.description: A cell or range, e.g. "B4", "A1:D10" or "Sheet1!B2:F2"

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

name: get_formula_range
title: Get formula range
